metadata.title: Miniver Cheevy
metadata.source_text: Edwin Arlington Robinson poem, adapted as song-13.txt
metadata.timing_source: first-pass uniform lyric-line timing from measured master WAV; refine with forced alignment if needed
metadata.style: Black-and-white early twentieth-century portrait cinema: one melancholy mustached man in a formal suit against rough painterly historical backgrounds, restrained surreal overlays for the old-world fantasies. No text, captions, or watermark.

cast.lead: Miniver Cheevy, a lean, wistful, self-dramatizing man born too late

metadata.prompt_rule: Prompts describe visual scenes only; never render lyric text onscreen.
metadata.completed_video_assignment_note: 8 existing MP4 clips randomly assigned as done beats; clips are 5.208s and cover the ~5.11s beat durations.

beats.lyric_text: Miniver Cheevy, child of scorn
beats.image_prompt: Portrait of Miniver Cheevy isolated against a rough painterly wall, weary and proud, an opening image of a man out of step with his age. Black-and-white early twentieth-century portrait film, formal suit, melancholy theatrical expression, shallow depth of field, fine film grain, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Slow push-in on Miniver's unsmiling face; keep motion subtle and cinematic; preserve the same mustached man in a formal suit; no text.

beats.lyric_text: Grew lean while he assailed the seasons
beats.image_prompt: Miniver thinner and restless before a blurred storm of seasons in the mural behind him, shoulders drawn tight, resentment gathering. Black-and-white portrait film, fine grain, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Subtle side drift as the background seems to pass like seasons; Miniver stays nearly still, tense and lean.

beats.lyric_text: He wept that he was ever born
beats.image_prompt: Close portrait of Miniver with wet eyes and a fixed stare, private despair held inside a formal suit. Black-and-white early portrait cinema, shallow focus, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Slow inward push with barely perceptible breath; hold the sadness without melodrama.

beats.lyric_text: And he had reasons
beats.image_prompt: Miniver turns slightly away from the viewer, the wall behind him darkening into remembered grievances. Black-and-white painterly portrait, formal suit, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Small head turn, then hold on the unresolved look.
beats.video_extension_note: Existing clip is 5.208s, already slightly longer than this ~5.11s beat; trim to beat duration during assembly.

beats.lyric_text: Miniver loved the days of old
beats.image_prompt: Miniver gazes upward as if seeing a vanished antique world beyond the studio wall. Black-and-white portrait, painterly historical texture, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Slow tilt from his face toward imagined old light.

beats.lyric_text: When swords were bright and steeds were prancing
beats.image_prompt: Ghostly suggestions of bright swords and prancing horses appear in the painterly background behind Miniver. Black-and-white surreal portrait, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Gentle parallax between Miniver's portrait and imagined cavalry behind him.

beats.lyric_text: The vision of a warrior bold
beats.image_prompt: Miniver stands straighter, imagining himself as a heroic warrior in armor though still trapped in his suit. Black-and-white portrait fantasy, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Slow push-in as brief confidence enters his posture.

beats.lyric_text: Would set him dancing
beats.image_prompt: Miniver breaks into a restrained, awkward dance, one hand lifting as fantasy overtakes him. Black-and-white formal portrait, slightly comic, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Small rhythmic sway, formal and slightly comic.

beats.lyric_text: Miniver sighed for what was not
beats.image_prompt: Miniver exhales toward an empty space beside him, longing for an absent world. Black-and-white portrait with negative space, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Slow lateral drift into the empty space beside him.
beats.video_extension_note: Existing clip is 5.208s, already slightly longer than this ~5.11s beat; trim to beat duration during assembly.

beats.lyric_text: And dreamed, and rested from his labors
beats.image_prompt: Miniver seated or heavy-shouldered, eyes softening into a dream while the room blurs. Black-and-white painterly portrait, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Soft rack-focus dream transition.

beats.lyric_text: He dreamed of Thebes and Camelot
beats.image_prompt: Ancient Thebes and Camelot merge as painted ruins and towers behind Miniver. Black-and-white surreal historical portrait, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Dreamlike parallax through ruins and castle shapes.

beats.lyric_text: And Priam's neighbors
beats.image_prompt: Classical figures and Trojan stonework suggested in the mural behind Miniver, half memory and half delusion. Black-and-white portrait, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Slow pan across mythic background texture while Miniver holds still.
beats.video_extension_note: Existing clip is 5.208s, already slightly longer than this ~5.11s beat; trim to beat duration during assembly.

beats.lyric_text: Miniver mourned the ripe renown
beats.image_prompt: Miniver in a formal mourning pose, head lowered for old heroic fame. Black-and-white dramatic portrait, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Slow push down from face to clasped hands.

beats.lyric_text: That made so many a name so fragrant
beats.image_prompt: Faint laurel wreaths and old engraved-name shapes hover in the background, not readable, while Miniver looks reverent. Black-and-white portrait, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Gentle light bloom around symbolic laurels; avoid readable writing.

beats.lyric_text: He mourned Romance, now on the town
beats.image_prompt: Romance personified as a shabby elegant silhouette disappearing into a modern street-like blur behind Miniver. Black-and-white painterly portrait, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Slow pull-back as the ideal slips away.

beats.lyric_text: And Art, a vagrant
beats.image_prompt: Miniver watches a wandering artist silhouette vanish into rough abstract brushwork. Black-and-white surreal portrait, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Soft drift following the disappearing figure.

beats.lyric_text: Miniver loved the Medici
beats.image_prompt: Miniver poses like an old Renaissance patron, imagining velvet, marble, and courtly power. Black-and-white portrait fantasy, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Slow regal push-in.

beats.lyric_text: Albeit he had never seen one
beats.image_prompt: The Renaissance vision falters; Miniver looks uncertain before a blank museum-like wall. Black-and-white portrait, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Subtle blink and deflation.

beats.lyric_text: He would have sinned incessantly
beats.image_prompt: Miniver smiles faintly with dangerous, theatrical self-importance, tempted by decadent power. Black-and-white portrait, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Slow shadow crossing his face.

beats.lyric_text: Could he have been one
beats.image_prompt: Miniver reaches toward an imagined ring or seal of power that is not there. Black-and-white Renaissance-tinged portrait, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Small hand motion ending in emptiness.

beats.lyric_text: Miniver cursed the commonplace
beats.image_prompt: Miniver scowls at plain modern surroundings, disgusted by ordinary life. Black-and-white portrait, formal suit, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Quick restrained push-in on the scowl.
beats.video_extension_note: Existing clip is 5.208s, already slightly longer than this ~5.11s beat; trim to beat duration during assembly.

beats.lyric_text: And eyed a khaki suit with loathing
beats.image_prompt: Miniver looks down at an imagined khaki suit with exaggerated contempt. Black-and-white portrait, dry comic edge, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Tilt down to the plain cloth, then back to his face.

beats.lyric_text: He missed the mediæval grace
beats.image_prompt: Miniver dreams of medieval arches and candlelit stone behind him. Black-and-white gothic portrait fantasy, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Slow reveal of gothic shapes in the painted wall.

beats.lyric_text: Of iron clothing
beats.image_prompt: Armor plates appear as an impossible overlay on Miniver's suit, heavy and absurdly noble. Black-and-white surreal portrait, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Metallic glint, slow push toward the armor illusion.

beats.lyric_text: Miniver scorned the gold he sought
beats.image_prompt: Miniver turns away from coins or golden light while clearly drawn toward it. Black-and-white portrait with a restrained symbolic glow, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Small recoil followed by a lingering glance.

beats.lyric_text: But sore annoyed was he without it
beats.image_prompt: Miniver pats empty pockets and looks irritated, the fantasy collapsing into need. Black-and-white portrait, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Tiny frustrated gesture, then hold.
beats.video_extension_note: Existing clip is 5.208s, already slightly longer than this ~5.11s beat; trim to beat duration during assembly.

beats.lyric_text: Miniver thought, and thought, and thought
beats.image_prompt: Miniver stares forward, trapped in circular thought as background brushwork swirls. Black-and-white portrait, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Slow circling-camera feeling, but keep the portrait grounded.

beats.lyric_text: And thought about it
beats.image_prompt: The portrait becomes stiller and more boxed-in, thought hardening into paralysis. Black-and-white formal portrait, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Freeze-like hold with minimal breathing motion.
beats.video_extension_note: Existing clip is 5.208s, already slightly longer than this ~5.11s beat; trim to beat duration during assembly.

beats.lyric_text: Miniver Cheevy, born too late
beats.image_prompt: Miniver stands between an antique world and a modern blur, visibly misplaced. Black-and-white portrait, historical fantasy fading, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Slow split-focus drift between past and present.

beats.lyric_text: Scratched his head and kept on thinking
beats.image_prompt: Miniver scratches his head, puzzled and stubbornly self-absorbed. Black-and-white portrait, dry comic resignation, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Small hand-to-head gesture, slight sway.
beats.video_extension_note: Existing clip is 5.208s, already slightly longer than this ~5.11s beat; trim to beat duration during assembly.

beats.lyric_text: Miniver coughed, and called it fate
beats.image_prompt: Miniver coughs into his hand, then composes himself as if naming destiny. Black-and-white portrait, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Brief cough motion, then settle into resignation.
beats.video_extension_note: Existing clip is 5.208s, already slightly longer than this ~5.11s beat; trim to beat duration during assembly.

beats.lyric_text: And kept on drinking
beats.image_prompt: Miniver lowers his eyes toward a glass just out of frame, ending in weary repetition. Black-and-white portrait, no text.
beats.video_prompt: Slow downward tilt and fade-out.
